(2) The woman in the maroon top walks along a sunny city sidewalk, waving and laughing. The camera follows her in a handheld movement. (3) The scene shifts to the woman in the maroon top sitting outdoors, holding denim jackets and white shopping bags, speaking animatedly. (4) A transition screen with a colorful tiki-style pattern and the text 'A FEW MOMENTS LATER' appears. (5) The two women are walking on a sidewalk next to a busy road; the woman in the checkered top is looking at her phone while the other speaks to her. (6) Indoors in a studio setting with warm lighting, the woman in maroon wears glasses and shows a speed test app on her smartphone displaying '109 Mbps'. (7) The woman in maroon is in a bedroom-like setting wearing a navy sailor-style uniform, speaking directly to the camera with high energy. (8) On-screen graphics display cellular setting menus and a website for eSIM data plans. (9) The woman is seen sitting inside a moving train carriage and walking through a scenic park with a lake, while continuing to demonstrate the use of her phone.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo electronic BGM starts immediately. Two female voices count 'One, Two, Three, Four' with high energy and rising intonation. (2) A female voice speaks in Traditional Chinese with a friendly, conversational tone, discussing video editing. The BGM remains steady in the background. (3) A subtle digital 'pop' sound effect occurs during a transition. A comedic skit dialogue ensues between two females, one sounding teasing and the other slightly frustrated about slow internet. (4) A loud 'whoosh' transition SFX marks a shift to a professional narrative tone. The main speaker describes the '威訊 eSIM' service with clear articulation. (5) Frequent 'ding' and digital UI clicks occur as visual graphics of speed tests and apps appear. The voice remains energetic and positive throughout the detailed explanation of features like 5G connectivity and data plans. (6) The video concludes with a strong, enthusiastic vocal call-to-action regarding a discount code, over the continuing upbeat electronic music.
